title: Spark 2.0: Large-Scale Web-Based Gaussian Splatting Engine
summary: Spark 2.0 is a high-performance web-based rendering engine developed by World Labs for massive 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It implements hierarchical Level-of-Detail (LoD) and the streamable .RAD format to visualize environments with billions of splats in real-time.
research_notes: Introduces a custom .RAD file format supporting HTTP Range requests for progressive loading and a Rust-powered LoD builder for processing billions of splats.

evolution.summary: Following the 2.0 launch, the engine added SparkXr for immersive WebXR support and experimental linear blend skinning for animated splats. It evolved from a simple renderer into a comprehensive streaming platform for composite 3D worlds.
